name: plumb
description: Marketplace for Plumb, a local-first durable memory wiki for Claude Code. Plumb stores decisions and context as markdown, indexes it with hybrid vector + keyword retrieval, and injects the relevant pages into every prompt. Everything runs on your machine.

plugins.name: plumb
plugins.description: Durable memory for Claude Code: a local markdown wiki with hybrid retrieval, automatic prompt injection, and tools to read and update it. Includes setup, diagnosis, seeding from memory you already have, and a real uninstall.
